summary: Two levers mattered, both about how the fixed 5 minutes is spent. (1) Tokens-per-step: halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 (grad_accum 2->1) bought 2x more optimizer updates and -0.0105 bpb (1.012347 -> 1.001892); going further to 2**17 at depth 8 was worse (1.007828), and scaling all LRs 1.4x at 2**18 was flat (1.002599), so the baseline LRs are fine and the win is genuinely update-count, not LR. (2) Model size: at 2**18, DEPTH 8->10 (dim 512->640) gave 0.986791, the best result; DEPTH 12 (dim 768) regressed to 0.994629, so ~depth 10 is the optimum here. At depth 10, batch 2**17 was a tie (0.987351) but at half the VRAM (34.3 vs 67.8 GB). Next I would sweep depth 9-11 at dim 640 more finely, retune matrix LR specifically at depth 10 (dim-scaling rule is untested at this width), and try trading MLP ratio 4->3 for another layer or two at fixed FLOPs.
